reviews.content: Law 3: maximum eleven players; a match cannot begin or continue if either team has fewer than seven. If the number falls below seven because one or more players deliberately leave, the referee is not obliged to stop play and may apply advantage, but cannot restart after the ball goes out until the team has at least seven.
reviews.finding: The relevant Arabic clauses are visually readable. No temporary-protocol exception was found in this passage.

reviews.content: Law 7: the half-time interval must not exceed 15 minutes; competition rules state its duration, and it may only be changed with the referee's permission.
reviews.finding: The substantive Arabic clauses used by DRAFT-18 are visually readable.

reviews.content: Law 10: a goal is scored when the whole ball crosses the goal line between the posts and under the crossbar, provided the scoring team committed no offence or infringement; a goalkeeper throwing the ball directly into the opponents' goal results in a goal kick.
reviews.finding: The substantive Arabic clauses used by DRAFT-10 and DRAFT-15 are visually readable. A non-substantive extraction control marker does not affect these clauses.
